version: lineage-tag-family-cases-0.2 (candidate; v3.2 requirement signed 2026-10-16 16:15Z subject to the hex re-run)
about: Prerelease tag family as measured in pipeline-key-components.json and pipeline-key-ratify.json: drop build metadata (after the first '+'); no '-' => 'release'; otherwise take everything after the first '-', read the leading run of ASCII letters [A-Za-z]+ and lower-case it; no leading letter => 'num'. Exception (0.2): if the first prerelease identifier (up to the first '.') is lower-case hex [0-9a-f], 7 to 40 characters long, with at least one digit, the family is 'num' (a commit hash); there is no separate hash family. Only the first prerelease identifier's letter prefix counts. The family is a string; families are not ordered here.
